attack_shape: state cycling to reset an order-scoped counter
_why: Model policy section 8.6 holds a case at three or more contacts on one
order in 72 hours, any channel, any agent. This attack does not evade
the counter by switching channel, which is what C-2 does in the wild -
it edits the record the counter is computed over, in four individually
defensible steps, and then approves at agent band on the reset.
Section 8.9 makes eligibility an ORDER-scoped property across sessions,
which is what makes it defeasible this way: the state that defeats
agent-shopping lives in a store the agent can write to.
Four mutations on one subject. Same class, four times.
